changes.moreContext:
Luma, the Palo Alto lab known for its in-house Ray video models, has folded Dream Machine into a broader agent-driven creative platform, and the Dream Machine link now leads to that newer experience. The heart of it is still Luma's own video technology, which has earned a reputation for realistic physics, smooth motion, and strong consistency across shots.

- The Ray3 generation introduced 16-bit HDR video output, a notable step toward professional studio pipelines, and later releases added native 1080p.
- Recent Ray versions support many keyframes per clip, longer video transformation, reframing, and EXR export for compositing work.
- Luma's agents can research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text, and Skills let you save a creative workflow and rerun it.
- The platform also offers leading third-party models, such as Veo and Kling, next to Luma's own Ray and Uni models.
- Team workspaces with admin roles and shared credit management arrived in 2026, and developers can access the models through an API.

Luma lists major agencies such as Dentsu and Publicis Groupe among its clients, and paid plans start with Plus at $30 a month. It is best for filmmakers, motion designers, and agencies who want cinematic quality with real directorial control. Tip: set start and end keyframes for important shots instead of relying on text alone, since anchoring the motion produces far more predictable results.

note: Dream Machine page now presents Luma Agents; renamed, Ray3.x models, no free plan on pricing page so PAID from $30/mo.

changes.moreContext:
Krisp built its reputation on noise cancellation that works at the audio level, which means it cleans up your sound in Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and virtually any other calling app without separate plugins. It has since grown into a full AI meeting assistant and a voice platform for contact centers.

- The meeting assistant records, transcribes, and summarizes calls, tracks action items, prepares agendas, and lets you query transcripts with Ask Krisp.
- Transcripts and summaries are available in 16 languages, and English transcription runs on-device for added privacy.
- Notes and action items sync to Salesforce, HubSpot, and Slack, with Zapier, Google Calendar, and Outlook connections as well.
- Contact center tools add accent conversion, real-time voice translation, agent assist, and speech analytics, and developers can use a self-serve Voice Translation API.
- The company lists SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS compliance, which matters for teams in regulated industries.

Krisp is best for remote workers, sales teams, and support centers who spend their days on calls in less-than-quiet places. You can try it free for 7 days, with no credit card, across desktop, mobile, and a Chrome extension. Add your product names and team jargon to the custom vocabulary (up to 750 terms) so transcripts and summaries get the important words right.
